mgPerUnitNote: 10 mg per cartridge (porous plug); each cartridge delivers 4 mg. About 20 min of frequent continuous puffing per cartridge. Puffs per cartridge not stated on the Canadian sources seen.

dosingNotes: More than 10 cigarettes/day: 21 mg weeks 1-6, 14 mg weeks 7-8, 7 mg weeks 9-10. Under 10/day, under 45 kg, or cardiovascular disease: 14 mg for 6 weeks, then 7 mg for 2-4 weeks. Reassess if needed beyond 6 months.
notes: Kenvue's Canadian brand, sold as 'NicoDerm' (US 'NicoDerm CQ' is Haleon). The 7 mg step for lighter smokers is 2-4 weeks in Canada, against 2 weeks in the US.

dosingNotes: Canadian retailer text: under 20 cigarettes/day, start at Step 2 (14 mg) for 6-8 weeks, then Step 3 (7 mg) for 3-4 weeks. If cravings persist on 14 mg, try 21 mg.

dosingNotes: 2 mg if you smoke less than a pack a day, 4 mg if more. Most people need about 10 pieces/day. Chew until a strong taste, park, repeat for about 30 min.
